delegation-id.description: Stable delegation identifier issued by a trusted authority; scope it to issuer-id and do not treat a delegate's self-assertion as verified authority.

issuer-id.description: Identifier of the authority that issued this delegation.

parent-id.description: Parent delegation identifier when this authority was re-delegated; this records authority lineage, not an agent orchestration hierarchy.

description: An authority-issued delegation context with issuer, issuance time and optional parent delegation, for tracing durable delegated authority across events. Based on OCSF 1.9.0: https://schema.ocsf.io/1.9.0/objects/delegation.
name: delegation
